# ash_money v0.2.6 - Table of Contents

The extension for working with money types in Ash.

## GUIDES

- [Home](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Tutorials
  - [Getting Started With AshMoney](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/getting-started-with-ash-money.md)

- About AshMoney
  - [Change Log](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- AshMoney
  - [AshMoney](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/AshMoney.md): `AshMoney` provides a type for working with money in your Ash resources.
  - [AshMoney.Types.Money](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/AshMoney.Types.Money.md): A money type for Ash that uses the `ex_money` library.

- AshPostgres
  - [AshMoney.AshPostgresExtension](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/AshMoney.AshPostgresExtension.md): Installs the `money_with_currency` type and operators/functions for Postgres.

- Internals
  - [Comparable.Type.Decimal.To.Money](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Decimal.To.Money.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Float.To.Money](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Float.To.Money.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Integer.To.Money](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Integer.To.Money.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Money.To.Decimal](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Money.To.Decimal.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Money.To.Float](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Money.To.Float.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Money.To.Integer](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Money.To.Integer.md)
  - [Comparable.Type.Money.To.Money](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Comparable.Type.Money.To.Money.md)

## Mix Tasks

- Internals
  - [mix ash_money.add_to_ash_postgres](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshMoney.AddToAshPostgres.md): Adds AshMoney.AshPostgresExtension to installed_extensions and installs :ex_money_sql.
  - [mix ash_money.install](https://ash-money.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshMoney.Install.md): Installs AshMoney. Should be run with `mix igniter.install ash_money`
